LocaleResource.Name: Plugins.Description.SmartStore.OutputCache
LocaleResource.Value: Allows the temporary storage of entire shop pages and thus contributes to a considerable increase in performance.

LocaleResource.Name: AdminInstruction
LocaleResource.Value:
For advanced users only! The bottom grid lists all cacheable routes. A route is made up of MVC area (optional), controller and action name ([area/]controller/action). Both parent and child actions can be set as cacheable. Child action output gets cached along with the parent output ONLY when its route was explicitly specified. Otherwise the child action is executed for each request, even when the parent output has been served from the cache (Donut Hole Caching).

To remove all cached pages for a specific route, click the Invalidate button in the corresponding row. Click Delete route to delete the route as a whole (thus making it uncacheable). To change the caching duration of a specific route, click the corresponding 'Duration' cell in the grid. Accept the changes with a click on Save changes or discard them by clicking Cancel changes.

LocaleResource.Name: AdminInstruction.InvalidateTag
LocaleResource.Value: Enter a comma-separated list of tags, whose cached items should be deleted from the cache store. A tag is made up of a prefix and an entity id, e.g. 'p1234' for a product entity with the id 1234 (other prefixes are: c = category, m = manufacturer, b = blog, n = news, t = topic). Invalidating by tag p1234 actually means: "Delete all cached pages in which the product with id 1234 gets somehow displayed".

LocaleResource.Name: TaskName
LocaleResource.Value: Remove expired output cache items from database

LocaleResource.Name: IsEnabled.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Turns output caching on or off.

LocaleResource.Name: ProviderSystemName.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies the active storage provider. 'Memory' is the fastest, but not suitable for web farms. Choose 'Database' or any other distributed storage - e.g. 'Redis' - when running in a a web farm.

LocaleResource.Name: DefaultCacheDuration.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Number of seconds the pages should be kept in cache on the server.

LocaleResource.Name: AutomaticInvalidationEnabled.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies whether cache entries should be removed automatically when their dependencies change (dependencies are data entities like product, category, blog post etc.). This is highly recommended as this will update your cache instantly, if e.g. the price of a product changes.

LocaleResource.Name: CacheAuthenticatedRequests.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies whether caching will apply even if the user is authenticated. Beware though that cached pages are only varied by customer roles, not by specific customers. Uncheck this option if your shop generates customer specific content.

LocaleResource.Name: IgnoreNoCache.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies whether requests containing a 'Content-cache: no-cache' header will still return cached pages if available. Check this if you want to test output caching even if the browser forces the server to return a fresh page.

LocaleResource.Name: DebugMode.Hint
LocaleResource.Value: Specifies whether caching information should be added to the response header (X-SmartStore-Cached-On, X-SmartStore-Cached-Until).
